name: Dice & Coin
subtitle: Roll, flip, pick, decide.
description:
Lost the dice from the board game? Can't decide where to eat? Dice & Coin settles it in one tap, with real 3D dice that tumble across the table and land on a truly random face.

Roll up to six dice at once and get the total instantly. Flip a weighty gold coin and keep a running heads-and-tails tally. Pick a random number between any two values with a slot-machine spin. Or type in your own list of options and let the reel choose for you.

Every result is saved to a recent history for each mode, so there's no arguing about what was rolled. Results use your device's secure random number generator, so every roll is completely fair.
whatsNew: New List mode: enter your own options and spin to pick. Plus smoother 3D dice and a coin-flip tally.
